conditional_margin: Cauchy-Binet with endpoint rate 1/4 and least zero rate gamma_1^2 predicts D2(t,h) asymptotic C(h) exp[-alpha t], alpha=gamma_1^2-1/4, C(h)>0
algebraic_error_no_go: for every m>0, t^(-m)/exp(-alpha t) tends to infinity
slower_exponential_no_go: if beta<alpha, exp(-beta t)/exp(-alpha t)=exp((alpha-beta)t) tends to infinity
threshold: an enclosure E(t)<=C0 exp(-beta t) can certify the asymptotic sign from this comparison only if beta>=alpha, with coefficient control when beta=alpha
consequence: ordinary PNT or Euler-Maclaurin remainder bounds with algebraic decay cannot certify global large-heat D2 positivity; fixed absolute precision also fails
surviving_routes: exact symbolic cancellation leaving the leading positive pair
error bounds at the same spectral exponent alpha or faster
renormalization by exp(alpha t) with certified positive limit and remainder
acceptance_test: Derive the leading endpoint--least-zero coefficient and a remainder decaying strictly faster than exp[-(gamma_1^2-1/4)t], or produce an exact completed identity that avoids subtractive asymptotic certification.
